name: Andhra Pradesh State Data Centre Disaster Recovery Centre at IIDT Campus Tirupati
developer: Government of Andhra Pradesh ITE&C Department
notes: State government approved a Disaster Recovery Centre at IIDT Campus, Tirupati, to support the Andhra Pradesh State Data Centre; plan cited INR 195 crore under BOOT model.

name: Google AI Hub Visakhapatnam
developer: Google Cloud with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel
notes: Google announced a USD 15 billion, 2026-2030 AI hub in Visakhapatnam with gigawatt-scale data center operations and subsea gateway; Google later said it broke ground on the hub. Capacity recorded as 1000 MW based on gigawatt-scale description and trade press reporting that eventual capacity could top 1 GW.

name: Sify Rushikonda-Madhurawada AI Edge Data Center and Open Cable Landing Station
notes: Sify broke ground on a two-phase 50 MW data center and open cable landing station on 3.6 acres in the Rushikonda-Madhurawada IT Park; reported investment about USD 169 million.

name: Sify Paradesipalem 500 MW Data Center Expansion
notes: Andhra Pradesh approved additional land for Sify's 500 MW data center project in Visakhapatnam; earlier land allotments included Madhurawada and Paradesipalem parcels and a reported INR 15,266 crore investment.

name: Tillman Global Holdings Visakhapatnam Hyperscale Data Centre Campus
developer: Tillman Global Holdings with Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board
notes: APEDB signed an MoU with Tillman Global Holdings for a 300 MW hyperscale data centre campus in Visakhapatnam, planned over about 40 acres with proposed investment of about INR 15,000 crore.

name: Sattva Group Madhurawada IT and Data Centre Mixed-Use Development
notes: Andhra Pradesh allotted 30 acres at Hill No. 4, Madhurawada, for Sattva Group to develop IT/ITES space, retail, residential units, and data centres; capacity not disclosed.

name: Reliance Industries Giga-Scale AI Data Centre and Cable Landing Station
notes: Andhra Pradesh approved allotment of 854.97 acres in Vizianagaram district to Reliance Industries for a giga-scale AI data centre with cable landing station; proposed investment about INR 1.08 lakh crore. Capacity not disclosed in source.
